scientific_question: {"text": "Single-dose test of the norovirus dose_adjustment refit under the hourly natural-history clock. The question is not what each hull's best dose is, it is whether ONE dose_adjustment can sit inside all four class-binned CDC VSP IQRs simultaneously, so every tier carries the IDENTICAL ladder and the identical seeds; any per-hull ladder difference would confound the comparison. scientific_question: {"text": "ASCERTAIN-V1: the conditioned array that splits the ~18x conditional recorded-onset gap into channel vs transmission (truth) shares, declared before any cell ran. The channel exists (observation_model.onset_recording, default-off, additive) so this is a declared sweep, not a mechanism change: arms over the channel's two parameters (the symptomatic-at-confirmation gate and the once-per-case recall draw) PLUS the mild-stratum ascertainment corners expressed through the existing observation_model.syndrome_case_eligibility_by_severity ladder (mild rung -> 0: a mild case never presents and never dates -- the deep corner of the stratum the published investigation loses to recall and non-presentation). Scored against BOTH anchors: the record's 197 dated onsets / 0.173 before-share AND the held-out serology anchor covid.H5 (infections_total band [712, 960], never fitted). scientific_question: {"text": "Conditioned array for the cooperative-packet dose-law arm (COVID-COOP-02, merged PR #778): the full declared envelope cross -- n* {2,3,5} x carrier_loading {four envelope corners + interior} -- as arm points over the takeoff-conditioned lattice, each paired seed-for-seed with the beta-Poisson baseline arm on the same (theta, seed). The scientific question the canary could not answer: at full voyage scale, does any declared (n*, mu_dry, mu_wet) arm point land the takeoff-conditioned recorded_onsets/before_share record (~197 / 0.173) that the baseline law overshoots ~9-10x at every admissible Theta (THETA-SCREEN-V13)? The arm weights each channel's dose by its >=n*-packet share w_c = P(K >= n*) / mu_c over the declared occupancy model: the dry axis is monotone in mu inside its envelope (0.004 nearly inert, 0.1 partially live at n* = 2), the wet axis is nonmonotone -- qualifying-carrier share peaks at interior loading and falls as 1/mu at the high corner where copies fuse into fewer, bigger packets -- so the four corners bracket the wet axis in both directions and the interior sits near its weight peak. The bolus family is untouched (w = 1) and sets the hard floor. scientific_question: {"text": "FRAILTY-V1: continuous susceptibility heterogeneity — a declared per-host frailty multiplier on the infection hazard, the last named class of the SUSCEPT-V1 surviving set. SUSCEPT-V1 measured the binary immune-fraction reading of 'effective population is smaller than aboard' as susceptible-structure incapable (IMM75 reaches the truth band only at the 0.75 corner and fails the count and timing legs); CONSENSUS-50 declined partial-protection immunity as unsourced, so no protection fraction exists to fit — every frailty parameter on this design is a DECLARED corner, swept, never fitted to anchors. The mechanism differs from both SUSCEPT-V1 axes: instead of a binary immune share (removes hosts entirely) or a beta-shape retune (one mixing variable, theta-preserved), this arm multiplies a SECOND orthogonal mixing variable f_i into the hazard — hazard = 1 - exp(-s_i * f_i * d) with s_i the shipped beta draw and f_i a continuous per-host draw at mean pinned exactly 1.0, so E[challenge] is untouched and only the dispersion of the hazard moves. At cv > 0 the hyper-frail burn early and the effective susceptible pool thins as the voyage proceeds — count AND timing legs both addressable in principle, where the binary fraction moved count only. scientific_question: {"text": "Hazard-rate crossing assay on the AERO-SPLIT-01 partition architecture, opened by three measured negatives and one measured instrument readout. PARTNER-RATE-V1 measured reach flat (rate x0.25 -> conditional median 3,474 vs the record's 197); PLUME-DOSE-V1 measured per-partner dose flat over x0.05-x1.00 (medians 3,435-3,486, elasticity 0.004) and every per-activity ring knockout inert; ROUTE-ATTR-V1 measured the droplet dose reaching infected hosts as ~98% ring-side but bimodal per agent -- both channels sit above the infection threshold for nearly every host. The engine's hazard is single-hit Poisson: p = 1 - exp(-susceptibility * effective_dose) per challenged host-epoch (engines/transmission_core.py _dose_response_hazard). Under theta_profile_overrides, susceptibility_scale = theta*(alpha+beta)/alpha so E[susceptibility] = theta -- the Theta axis is exactly the mean-lambda axis, no arm grammar needed. If per-epoch lambda is already orders of magnitude above 1 at the declared Theta, every transmission knob is silent precisely because p_epoch ~ 1: the assays' flatness is then a lambda-calibration symptom, and this sweep finds where the conditional mass begins to respond -- the lambda ~ O(1) boundary -- and whether ANY Theta's takeoff-seed band contains 197.", "kind": "literal_description_from_candidate_design", "evidence": {"source_path": "picard_framework/runs/covid_lambda_cross_v1_design.json", "line_start": 1, "line_end": 1, "source_sha": "496a919ca3af4563da34b958db37e737b58bab4b", "permalink": "https://github.com/bckirkup/Crusher_to_the_Bridge/blob/496a919ca3af4563da34b958db37e737b58bab4b/picard_framework/runs/covid_lambda_cross_v1_design.json#L1"}}

scientific_question: {"text": "PROPENSITY-V1 clause canary: does the shipped persistent per-party contact-propensity multiplier (rhythm.participation_propensity, mode party, mean-pinned lognormal cv 0.8 on discretionary event classes) move the Theta 1e9 anchor's clause verdict? scientific_question: {"text": "The conditional-gap hunt under a period-faithful observational channel, anchored to serology rather than the record's own channel. LAMBDA-CROSS-V1 measured Theta as the first load-bearing knob (conditional recorded-mass median 3,486 -> 624 over x1.0 -> x0.001, elasticity 0.216) but with a shallow bend plus bimodal extinction: no row lands on the record. ROUTE-ATTR-V1 measured the funnel's broken rung: the channel confirms ~76% of infected (period-rough vs 712 of a serology-informed ~840) but dates 93-100% of confirmed cases at true onset where the record dated 197/712 = 27.7%. This design adds the record's own onset-recording structure as a channel arm and sweeps the hazard scale under it: (a) the symptomatic-at-confirmation gate — a case confirmed while asymptomatic enters the record undated, the record's symptomatic_at_specimen field (51% of DP positives contributed no onset date); (b) a recall/reporting draw covering interview loss, record-derivable as (197/712) / ~0.49 ~= 0.56.
